title: Centralized robot-account issuance and orphan-remediation playbook
creator: Ethan Brooks
description:
Problem: We lack a single, auditable issuance flow for non-human (service/robot) accounts that enforces least-privilege templates, assigns clear owners, and automatically remediates orphaned accounts. Current scattershot provisioning creates audit gaps, variable permissions, and operational toil for infra teams.

Goal: Ship a deterministic issuance playbook that covers: a) a canonical least-privilege template schema and template registry; b) UI + API for creating robot accounts using templates; c) ownership assignment and transfer flow tied to SSO groups; d) admission/enforcement for Dedicated/Private deploys; e) an orphan-detection and remediation job; and f) full audit logging for every lifecycle event.

Scope: This ticket covers design + implementation of the issuance API, template registry backend, ownership rules, orphan scanner, and Console create flow. It includes audit-event schema definitions and runbook for remedial actions. Hardware-level runtime/kernels are out of scope.

Non-goals: Rewriting all existing provisioners, migrating existing robot accounts automatically (we will onboard high-risk accounts via a separate migration plan).
acceptance_criteria: Template schema documented in Confluence and published to the template registry (fields: name, description, allowed_role_bindings, ttl_seconds, owner_required, rotation_policy, justification_link)
Console: 'Create service account' flow allows template selection and requires owner assignment or SSO-group binding; server returns 400 for missing required fields
API: POST /v1/service-accounts validates against template and emits structured audit event for create/assign/approve
Enforcement: Admission webhook (Private) or policy gate (Hosted/Dedicated) rejects creations that bypass templates or exceed allowed bindings
Orphan remediation job runs nightly, detects accounts with no valid owner for >7 days, and creates a labeled remediation ticket + escalates to oncall; soft-disable workflow exists
Audit: All lifecycle events (create, owner-change, role-change, rotate, delete, remediation) are available in Console audit view and mapped to logging/ELK fields for retention 1 year
SSO: SCIM/SSO group mapping allows auto-assignment of owners for allowed groups and logs the mapping decision
E2E tests exercising happy/unhappy paths and a small canary rollout plan documented in the release notes
Security review signed off and runbook shared with Incident Response and Platform teams
tasks: Design and freeze template JSON schema and validation rules
Build template registry service (CRUD endpoints) with RBAC-v2 protection
Extend 'redwoodctl' with 'sa create' that consumes templates and supports --owner and --sso-group flags
Console UI: create flow + template selector + owner input + owner verification UX
Server API: create/assign endpoints + validation + structured audit events (create/assign/approve)
Admission policy: implement webhook for Private that validates template usage and emits detailed rejection reasons
Orphan scanner: nightly job, detection heuristics, remediation ticket creator, and soft-disable path
Audit pipeline: add fields for sa.template, sa.owner_before, sa.owner_after, sa.remediation_action and wire to ELK indices
SSO integration: map SCIM group -> owner candidates and add owner auto-assignment policy (configurable per org)
Security review + threat model update + KMS/HSM integration notes for private key material
Create runbook: owner onboarding, transfer process, and remediation playbook for oncall
Prepare E2E tests and run canary in a single region; monitor cost/latency impact
comments: 2025-11-04 — Ethan Brooks: Initial draft of schema posted to Confluence (link below). Decided to require owner or SSO-group at creation; owner field cannot be blank. PM agreed this avoids silent orphans.

2025-11-06 — Maya Patel: UX wireframes attached. We need an inline owner verification step (ping owner via Slack/email) before the account becomes active — will prototype with optional verification toggle per org.

2025-11-10 — Security (Priya Rao): Recommend maximum ttl_seconds of 30 days by default for high-privilege templates and enforced rotation_policy. Also requested KMS-backed key storage for private deployments.

2025-11-12 — Eng: Decided on a 7-day grace window for orphan detection (agreed with infra and SRE). Orphan job will create a remediation ticket and soft-disable the account after 14 days unless claimed.
2025-11-15 — QA (Liam Costa): Found edge case: mass-imported accounts (legacy) with null owner cause scanner noise. We'll add a legacy import suppression flag and a one-time migration script.
2025-11-18 — Maya Patel: API contract approved in PR #8423. Backfill note: we'll create a migration epic for high-risk service accounts after this ship.
2025-11-20 — Security Review complete: small items to address (audit-field naming, retention policy). Security team approved conditional go-ahead pending fixes in PR #8476.
